title: Import --from-dir preserves source content
acceptance_criteria: import --from-dir keeps the source file's module name, files list, purpose and existing sections (Public API, Invariants, Change Log); the imported spec passes specsync check --strict immediately; the Change Log names the real source instead of Confluence; a source with no usable files list is refused loudly and counted as an error

answers.constraints: Generated specs stay draft status; module names stay validated through the shared portable component contract; no new external dependencies
